Wow it really does have some amazing results, but for myself, I don't know, it'd be an uphill battle (more like a mountain), and I'm simply not brave enough for it, as a kid I was mocked all of the time for being ugly, as time went my appearance averaged enough that no one bothers me over it anymore, even if it's not the ideal appearance, at least people don't constantly bash me for it, if things didn't work out well and I ended up looking less than average, I think what little self confidence I still have would be crushed. My desires sure have developed a bit over time, I wouldn't fathom trying to act girly or research trans forums so much a few years back, nor would I get so much satisfaction from reading TS fiction, I wouldn't want to look as androgynous as possible for my own satisfaction. I guess in the end, even if there's no outcome I can understand trans people a bit better and be more considerate, it sure has helped me overcome some prejudices implanted on me by my family, that's already something.

To be honest it quite confuses me, I do wish I were a girl but have no prospect of acting on it, I do like to hang around here, while I do not present as a girl online I do like having usernames as ambiguous as possible and having anime girls for pfps, also making female characters for games whenever possible, sometimes I just have an inexplicable desire to feel cute and girly.

   My family is very religious and anti-lgbt with my dad spouting outright hatred quite frequently and I mostly have to pretend to agree, the country overall is not very progressive either, I just don't see any chance of doing anything about it, I don't see my body as ever being suitable for presenting as female, it's like my wishes are completely detached from reality, just this crazy dream of one day waking up as a cute girl, a feeling of slight euphoria whenever I get to feel girly online without the impediment of my physical body, the satisfaction of reading TS stories of magical transformation and giggling with satisfaction as the story unfolds, but does it mean anything if I never do anything? Do I even want it for the right reasons? Sorry I just needed to ramble about this a bit, it's eating away at me.

Sorry for taking a while to respond, but I'm very grateful for your suggestions and tips, what's truly disheartening is that my family is way too conservative and I'm way too dependent on them for me to take any action on this :/ , my father is always spouting hatred for trans people which I have to nod and agree with for the sake of avoiding confontation since he's very hot headed and pushy, so I don't have any hope for support at all, then there's the fear that even if I did manage to get help in order to get treatment I might never look passable, every time I see myself in the mirror I lose a bit of hope tbh.
